projects.name: Hewi - Nad Al Sheba 4
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a next-generation community park in Nad Al Sheba 4 as part of the Hewi Dubai initiative, an effort to redefine public spaces in Dubai through community-focused, culturally inspired design. The park is located between a mosque and a residential neighbourhood, chosen specifically for its walkability and strong sense of community.

This modern park draws inspiration from the traditional Emirati fareej and is co-designed with residents to meet the needs and preferences of the surrounding community. Key features include Al Decha, a shaded gathering space near the mosque, offering a calm retreat for elders to connect over Arabic coffee or tea. Al Saaha serves as a flexible indoor-outdoor venue for events, workshops, and celebrations, encouraging residents to take ownership of their shared environment.

The park also includes Al Yalsa, a family-oriented seating area overlooking a children’s play zone, perfect for relaxation and informal gatherings. Additional design elements such as meandering paths and nature-based play areas promote intergenerational interaction, physical activity, and exploration. Together, these features establish a vibrant, inclusive space that celebrates local culture while encouraging healthy, social lifestyles.

Hewi - Nad Al Sheba 4 is a greenfield park project in Dubai, valued at USD 20.0 million, at concept. Developed by Dubai Future Foundation (Dff),Dubai Municipality (Dm). No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Mercer House by Ellington Properties - Al Thanyah Fifth
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a residential tower named Mercer House in Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT). It comprises two residential towers, one standing at 46 stories and the other at 39 stories, housing around 600 units. These towers are connected by a podium that integrates a combination of retail outlets and upscale food and beverage spaces. The project introduces a variety of multi-family residential units, ranging from efficient studios to spacious one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, along with four penthouses. The development includes a 45,000 sq. ft. beach club and 25,000 sq. ft. of retail space on the ground and podium levels, marking a significant milestone in the broader development of Uptown Dubai as a top-tier district and one of Dubai's most sought-after mixed-use communities.

Mercer House is set to stand out on Dubai's skyline with two towering residential structures atop a podium. Positioned at the core of DMCC's emerging Uptown Dubai district, the project offers a diverse range of multi-family residential units, including studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, and four penthouses.

Among its amenities, Mercer House features a 45,000 sq. ft. beach club and 25,000 sq. ft. of retail spaces on the ground and podium floors. The facilities include a beach club pool, an exclusive residents' pool, a sports hall with various courts for sports enthusiasts, and an array of dining options, community markets, and high-end retail offerings. This aims to strengthen Uptown Dubai's status as the preferred destination for work, living, and indulgence in Dubai.

Mercer House by Ellington Properties - Al Thanyah Fifth is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 300.0 million, at tender. projects.name: Khalid Bin Sultan City
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Khalid Bin Sultan City, a groundbreaking master-planned, mixed-use development spanning a 1.5-kilometer-long plot in Rodhat Al Sidir, Sharjah. The development will integrate 1,500 freehold residential units, including villas, townhouses, and apartments, designed with a focus on sustainability, comfort, and modern amenities. The city is divided into seven distinct neighborhoods, each centered around a public plaza serving as a social and wellbeing hub.

Khalid Bin Sultan City emphasizes a climate-smart, zero-waste approach, incorporating net-zero ready smart infrastructure, renewable energy systems, recycled water infrastructure, and sustainable mobility solutions. The pedestrian pathways are thoughtfully designed with shading elements such as native trees and colonnades to reduce heat and encourage walkability. The city features a continuous two-kilometer shaded linear oasis with running and cycling tracks, sculpture gardens, wellness areas, and shaded courtyards promoting social interaction and serenity.

In addition to residential offerings, the development will include a design and business district serving as an urban hub for creative economy incubators, cultural venues, retail, and entertainment spaces. The project also integrates cultural elements that celebrate Sharjah’s heritage through public art spaces and architecture reflecting local identity. The development aims to foster a cohesive, people-first community with health-focused amenities, children's hubs, wellness clinics, sports facilities, and outdoor cafés.

 

Khalid Bin Sultan City is a greenfield mega urban development project in Sharjah, valued at USD 1400.0 million, at concept. Developed by Beeah Tandeef. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: DIFC Heights Tower

The project involves the construction of the Heights Tower, a mixed-use live-work-play destination located within the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). The development occupies the final plot within the original DIFC district and is adjacent to the upcoming Four Seasons Private Residences. It is set to offer an exclusive address in the heart of the DIFC district, offering seamless connectivity to Gate Avenue, a key retail and lifestyle destination.

Heights Tower will feature 366 luxury residences, ranging from one-bedroom apartments to four-bedroom duplexes, spread across 32 floors. Additionally, there will be seven dedicated floors for office spaces, including shell-and-core units, as well as retail spaces for F&B outlets and stores. The development is designed to cater to ambitious professionals and offers an elevated urban lifestyle.

The development will incorporate biophilic design elements with interlocking geometries that foster an environment of well-being and creativity. Communal workspaces are designed to be smart and contactless, providing an innovative approach to the modern work-life balance. A range of amenities will be available, including a family lounge, a temperature-controlled outdoor swimming pool, and a state-of-the-art fitness centre. 

The building will offer panoramic views of Dubai Creek Harbour to the east and the Sheikh Zayed Road skyline to the west, with select units providing views of the iconic Burj Khalifa.

projects.name: Yas Riva by Aldar Properties - Yas Island

The project involves the construction of the villas within Yas Island, Abu Dhabi. Offering both canal-front and canal-accessible homes designed to provide a serene waterfront lifestyle. The project includes 151 four-, five-, and six-bedroom canal-front and canal-accessible villas. Residents will enjoy a range of amenities, including a health and wellness center on the water’s edge, featuring a spa, gym, adults’ and kids’ pools, and a sunken firepit. The community is further enriched with landscaped gardens, three parks, and various recreational facilities, such as padel courts, outdoor fitness areas, and an amphitheater.

Uniquely positioned as one of Abu Dhabi’s few residential developments with direct canal access, Yas Riva features canal-front villas with private docks, enabling residents to explore the surrounding waterways by boat. The community’s design draws inspiration from the natural landscape, with the flowing curves of the villas mirroring the gentle movement of water. The minimalist design of these villas complements the lush greenery, creating a peaceful living environment.

Yas Riva is designed with sustainability in mind, targeting a 3 Pearl Estidama rating for the villas and a 2 Pearl Estidama rating for the overall community. The development incorporates sustainable practices to reduce carbon emissions and water usage, including the use of recycled materials and low-carbon construction methods. Additionally, Yas Riva is pursuing a 2-star Fitwel rating, aligning with global standards for promoting healthy communities.

Yas Riva by Aldar Properties - Yas Island is a greenfield low rise (1 -3) project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 100.0 million, at under construction (100.0 percent complete). The project introduces a refined collection of 84 ultra-luxury waterfront apartments and 19 villas. The residences are designed to blend private homeownership with five-star resort services, offering both exclusivity and convenience in a world-class coastal setting.

The apartments range from suites and one- and two-bedroom units to exclusive three-bedroom sky villas. Rising up to 12 stories, they offer direct beach access and panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and Hajar Mountains. The villas, available in three, four, and five-bedroom layouts, are arranged over three floors and each features a private garden, infinity pool, and dedicated boat dock. All units are finished with contemporary aesthetics inspired by Anantara’s Thai-Arabian design ethos, including floor-to-ceiling windows and elevated interiors.

Amenities include a private beach, infinity pool, Anantara Signature Spa, yoga studio, cinema room, kids’ play area, fitness center, and on-site dining. Residents also benefit from Anantara’s à la carte services such as in-home dining, concierge, valet, and transport by buggy. 

The project is part of the broader Mina masterplan and supports Ras Al Khaimah’s ongoing efforts to enhance its appeal as a luxury residential and tourism destination.

projects.name: Damac Casa Tower - Al Sufouh
projects.description:
This project involves the construction of a 2 basements and 46-story residence tower named Damac Casa in Dubai Media City, Al Sufouh, The tower boasts a wide range of living options, on levels 2 to 48, and residents can choose from luxurious 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. For those seeking even more opulence, levels 49 to 58 offer exquisite 3, 4, and 5-bedroom ultra-luxury apartments.

The tower offers lap pools, a state-of-the-art boxing ring, a climbing wall, a jogging track, ethereal sky yoga spaces, and a luxurious spa. In addition, it is equipped with its own on-site emergency room to cater to any medical needs that may arise. Residents also have the convenience of a diet consultant and physiotherapist available on-site to support their health and wellness goals.

Situated in the Al Sufouh area with Dubai's iconic Palm as its backdrop, the tower captures the peacefulness of island living in every aspect of its design. Taking cues from the lotus flower, which thrives in aquatic surroundings, the tower aims to elevate residents' experiences with unmatched water vistas. The tower reimagines the concept of living on a vertical island, offering residents an extraordinary blend of water, tranquility, and luxury.

Damac Casa Tower - Al Sufouh is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 200.0 million, at under construction (8.0 percent complete). Developed by Damac Properties Co. Llc,Aqua Virdis Investment Llc. Lead consultant Killa Design,Ae7 Consultant (Dubai),Killa Design. Main contractor China Nuclear Industry 22Nd Construction Co. Ltd.. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Hadley Heights 2 - Dubai Sports City
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Hadley Heights 2, a 26-storey residential building with 230 units located in Dubai Sports City, Dubai. The project is co-branded with three-time Olympic gold medallist Tom Dean, marking the world's first Olympic champion-branded residence.

Hadley Heights 2 is designed around the principles of performance, wellness, and innovation, offering Olympic-level amenities aimed at fostering peak physical and mental well-being. These include AI-powered gyms, rooftop running tracks, outdoor CrossFit zones, immersive sports simulators, wellness parks, and children’s play areas. The development is further distinguished by its bold, aerodynamic architecture and next-generation digital infrastructure.

Hadley Heights 2 - Dubai Sports City is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 32.7 million, at concept. Developed by Leos International. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Azizi Ruby - Jumeirah Village Circle
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Azizi Ruby, a contemporary, nature-inspired residential tower located in the vibrant Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC). Designed to balance tranquility with modern convenience, Azizi Ruby offers seamless connectivity to Dubai’s major business, entertainment, and retail hubs, while being surrounded by lush greenery and over 30 landscaped parks. The tower consists of 3 basements, a ground floor, 4 podium levels, and 13 residential floors, along with a rooftop offering stunning skyline views. The building features a variety of residential units, including studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom homes.

Each living space fosters a family-friendly atmosphere, complemented by an array of amenities such as a clubhouse, a cinema, two swimming pools, a fully-equipped gym, dedicated children’s play areas, a BBQ area, and more. The prime location of JVC ensures easy access to key areas of Dubai, contributing to high rental demand.

Azizi Ruby offers an excellent investment opportunity in a rapidly developing community, with a well-rounded offering of comfort and convenience.

Azizi Ruby - Jumeirah Village Circle is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 80.0 million, at concept. Developed by Azizi Developments. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Violet - Damac Hills 2
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Violet which features 526 residential units located within Damac Hills 2. The project offers range of amenities an extensive range of amenities designed to cater to diverse interests and enhance the community living experience. These amenities include an amphitheater for cultural events and performances, barbecue areas for outdoor gatherings, a boating lake for leisurely activities, and a butterfly garden for nature enthusiasts. Sports enthusiasts can enjoy facilities such as a cricket pitch, football pitch, volleyball court, and cycle paths for recreational activities.

For relaxation and leisure, there are features like a lazy river, man-made beach, and zen garden. Families can enjoy the petting farm, play areas, and picnic parks, while thrill-seekers can partake in activities like paintball and water slides. There are also facilities for outdoor fitness, such as an outdoor gymnasium and jogging track.

Additionally, there are amenities for socializing, including an outdoor cinema and snack bar. With swimming pools, water playgrounds, and splash pads, there are options for water-based recreation as well. Overall, these amenities contribute to a luxurious and fulfilling community living experience, providing something for everyone to enjoy.

projects.name: One Canal - Dubai Water Canal

projects.name: Mandarin Oriental Jumeirah Golf Estates
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of the Mandarin Oriental Jumeirah Golf Estates, Dubai, marking the brand's first dedicated golf resort with branded residences and its third property in the city. The resort will be situated within the prestigious Jumeirah Golf Estates development in the southwestern part of Dubai, envisioned as an elevated, tranquil escape where space, wellbeing, and nature converge.

The property will comprise 121 spacious, beautifully designed rooms and suites. In addition, there will be 97 branded residences ranging from three- to six-bedroom villas, each with its own amenities and private access to a lounge, meeting space, pool, and fitness areas.

A highlight of the resort will be The Spa at Mandarin Oriental, presenting an extensive range of the Group's signature wellness, beauty, and massage treatments in immersive facilities set amid natural surrounds. Nearly 5,000 square metres of space will be dedicated to holistic wellbeing, featuring male and female-only pools, an outdoor meditation area, a barber and a salon, alongside three additional swimming pools. This will be complemented by a comprehensive programme of wellness-led experiences integrated across the resort.

As part of the wider Jumeirah Golf Estates, the Next Chapter development, guests and residents of Mandarin Oriental Jumeirah Golf Estates will enjoy access to exceptional leisure amenities. These include world-class golf facilities with an 18-hole championship course, driving range, academy, and agronomy programmes, complemented by a Golf Clubhouse with lobby and membership lounges, a pro shop, sports bar, gym, and extensive locker facilities. In addition, a dedicated Equestrian Centre and Clubhouse spanning over 7,000 square metres will offer indoor and outdoor arenas, training facilities, stabling, retail, and scenic riding trails. For younger guests, the resort itself will feature a fully serviced indoor and outdoor Kids' Club and a nursery.

Guests and residents will enjoy a choice of six dining venues, including two restaurants at the Golf Club and a Halfway Hut on the course, in addition to Mandarin Oriental's signature elevated gastronomy concepts. The property will also offer extensive meeting and event spaces, including a large ballroom and two outdoor venues, making it an exceptional destination for gatherings.

Mandarin Oriental Jumeirah Golf Estates is a greenfield resort project in Dubai, valued at USD 300.0 million, at concept. Developed by Wasl (Dubai Real Estate Corporation) (Drec),Mandarin Oriental,Wasl Asset Management. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. projects.name: HENGE Residences - Saadiyat Island

The project involves the construction of ten-storey residential complex located on Saadiyat Island, Abu Dhabi. This high-end residential project is a collaboration with the iconic Italian design house HENGE, marking its debut in the Abu Dhabi real estate market. The development comprises 166 units, including studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as two duplexes, with a total built-up area of over 400,000 sqft.

The residences are designed to offer a fusion of craftsmanship, elegance, and curated comfort. Each unit features bespoke furniture and materials exclusively selected and crafted by HENGE’s master artisans, providing an immersive experience in artisanal living. The interiors emphasize contemporary aesthetics, with finishes including natural marble, sintered stone, and natural wood accents, embodying a bespoke design ethos.

HENGE Residences is located just 20 minutes from Downtown Abu Dhabi and is close to key landmarks such as the Saadiyat Cultural District and NYU Abu Dhabi. The development is situated in the heart of Saadiyat Island’s Marina District, offering both convenience and a prestigious lifestyle. The project introduces a new standard of boutique, branded residences that blend luxury living with artistic expression.

To enhance residents' living experience, HENGE Residences offers a curated selection of lifestyle amenities, including 24/7 security, a padel court, a health club with sauna and steam rooms, a temperature-controlled swimming pool, dedicated children’s pool, smart home automation, and full concierge services. These features, along with the prime location, contribute to a high-end living environment.

projects.name: Bvlgari Resort & Mansions - Massnoua Island
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Bvlgari Resort & Mansions located in Massnoua Island, an ultra-luxury hospitality and residential development set on a private, horseshoe-shaped island just off the coast of downtown Abu Dhabi. The project blends Italian elegance with Arabian cultural identity in what is described as Bvlgari’s most ambitious development to date.

The resort component will feature a 90-key hotel comprising 60 guest rooms, including two signature Bvlgari Suites and a Bvlgari Penthouse, as well as 30 beachfront villas. Among these is a five-bedroom, 1,200 square metre Bvlgari Villa featuring a private park, beach, and a 20-metre pool.

The resort will be equipped with a wide range of high-end amenities including a 2,000 sqm Bvlgari Spa with a 25-metre lap pool, a 1,000 sqm fitness centre, and an outdoor deck with sweeping sea views. Additional facilities include fine dining venues such as Il Ristorante – Niko Romito, Hoseki, La Spiaggia, and a Turkish restaurant, along with Bvlgari’s signature Il Caffe, Bvlgari Dolci boutique, and La Galleria concept store. A state-of-the-art Yacht Club will anchor the development, offering a private beach, a 40-berth marina, exclusive membership, and access to extensive marine and water sports activities.

The residential component includes 90 private mansions ranging in size from 1,650 to 2,500 sqm. Eight ultra-luxury estates will feature private beaches, and several mansions will include individual docks capable of accommodating yachts up to 25 metres. All residences are designed to offer unobstructed views of the sea, the city skyline, or the island’s tranquil inner cove, blending international contemporary architecture with local design elements.

The development will be accessible via a purpose-built bridge or by sea, ensuring privacy and seamless connectivity. 

Bvlgari Resort & Mansions - Massnoua Island is a greenfield resort project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 500.0 million, at design. The developer is not yet recorded. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: The Wilds by Aldaar
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of The Wilds, a premium residential community in Dubai. Strategically located along Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road, opposite Global Village, the development offers a nature-centric living experience with a strong emphasis on sustainability and wellness.

The Wilds will feature approximately 1,700 homes, including five- and six-bedroom mansions, three- to five-bedroom villas, and one- to three-bedroom apartments. Each residence is designed to integrate seamlessly with eco corridors and green spaces, providing privacy and a tranquil living environment.

As the first community in the UAE to achieve LEED Platinum and Fitwel 3-star certifications, The Wilds is committed to sustainability and wellness. The development incorporates a diverse natural habitat, including native plant species, ponds, dry stream habitats, duck houses, manmade bird nests, and bee-keeping zones to promote biodiversity.

A key highlight of the project is The Nest, a signature community pavilion serving as a visual landmark and a space for wildlife observation and environmental learning. Additionally, a premium international school will be part of the development, featuring outdoor learning spaces and eco-focused facilities to support environmental education.

The Wilds will also include a retail hub, clubhouses, a nursery, a clinic, and two mosques, ensuring residents have access to essential services. Recreational amenities such as fitness zones, tennis, padel, and basketball courts, wellness pavilions, meditation spaces, resort-style swimming pools, and walking/cycling trails will further enhance the community’s lifestyle offerings.

Designed to be family-centric, the development will feature interactive play areas, splash pads, shallow streams, and inclusive playgrounds for people of determination. Adventure seekers and nature lovers will find plenty of opportunities to explore and unwind within the thoughtfully designed landscape.

The Wilds by Aldaar is a greenfield mega urban development project in Dubai, valued at USD 2000.0 million, at tender. Developed by Dubai Holding,Aldar Properties Pjsc. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

The community at Keturah Reserve boasts several communal spaces for residents to enjoy. The Park provides an outdoor space where residents can relax, socialize, or engage in recreational activities. The 'Dubai AI & Web 3.0 Campus' will serve as a hub for visionary entrepreneurs, disruptors, and engineers who possess a profound passion for emerging technologies. It will provide exceptional physical and digital infrastructure, including research and development facilities, accelerator programs, and collaborative workspaces, to attract, nurture, and expand AI companies.

The project is expected to significantly contribute to this growth by becoming a global hub for research, investment, and innovation. The project aims to attract over US$300 million in collective funds, accommodate more than 500 global AI and Web 3.0 start-ups, and create over 3,000 jobs by 2028. Over the next five years, the ambitious project aims to establish a dedicated campus spanning more than 100,000 square feet at the DIFC Innovation One premise. The primary focus of the campus will be on the utilization of AI and Web 3.0 within the financial services industry. It will offer a total of 221 luxurious apartments, including 52 studios, 80 one-bedroom apartments, 51 two-bedroom apartments, 28 three-bedroom apartments, and 10 penthouses on the 12th and 13th floors. These penthouses feature private pools and duplex layouts, providing an exclusive living experience. The structure will include three basement levels, a ground floor, 13 residential floors, and a roof, along with 126 meters of beachfront access. The plot area is 5,460 square meters (58,770 square feet). The development is designed to offer modern elegance and high-quality living across all units.

Azizi Wasel will also feature a wide range of amenities to enhance residents' lifestyles. The ground floor will include lounge bars, cafes, retail spaces, and restaurants, while the first floor will house a kids' play area, cinema room, game room, gym, spa, and steam room, alongside eight apartments. The second floor will offer a swimming pool and 14 additional apartments. The building will be equipped with three passenger lifts, one service lift, and two penthouse lifts for easy access. The parking facilities will provide one parking slot for studio, one-, and two-bedroom units, and two slots for three-bedroom apartments and penthouses.

Located strategically with easy access to key locations like Dubai International Airport, Sheikh Zayed Road, and popular attractions such as the Waterfront Market, Dubai Frame, and City Centre Deira, Azizi Wasel will offer a unique blend of waterfront luxury and urban convenience.

The project is poised to transform luxury living, introducing Dubai’s first climate-adaptive wellness community that marries British architectural sophistication with cutting-edge environmental technology. The first phase of Knightsbridge features a select array of 66 properties, including 4-bedroom townhouses and 5- and 6-bedroom villas, all exemplifying the pinnacle of luxury and sustainability. Highclere 4-Bedroom Townhouses: Ranging from 1,853 to 4,191 sq.ft in plot size and 3,937 to 3,971 sq.ft in built-up area, these townhouses are ideal for families. Grosvenor 5-Bedroom Villas: Offering plot sizes from 4,478 to 7,722 sq.ft and built-up areas of 5,657 sq.ft, these villas provide generous living space with elegant layouts and premium finishes. The villas further enhance the living experience with private jacuzzis, maid and driver’s rooms, chef and show kitchens, and a private cinema. The first phase encompasses a total plot area of 335,877 square feet, with 70% dedicated to green spaces. This pioneering development promises a unique living experience centered on wellness, luxury, and environmental harmony. Knightsbridge features bay-view popped-out windows, curved lines for optimal climate control, and a harmonious blend of yellow stone and metal cladding, making each home a masterpiece of design and sustainability. The project incorporates numerous sustainable features, including abundant green spaces, solar panels, a re-oxygenating waterfall, self-shading building terraces, a smart home system, EV charging stations, solar water heating, energy-efficient LED lighting, UV-proof double glazing, an insulated building envelope, a smart irrigation system, greywater recirculation with UV filters, and biodegradable reed-bed filtration for lake water. Residents will enjoy world-class amenities such as a lagoon, a running track, a Japanese Rapha Yoga deck, a Stargazing Tea Lounge, an outdoor cinema, and more. The project involves the construction of Therme Dubai, the world’s largest and tallest wellbeing resort, is set to rise in Zabeel Park, Dubai, covering 500,000 square feet and reaching 100 meters in height. The landmark project integrates wellness, leisure, and sustainability, redefining urban biodiversity and environmental responsibility. It will feature the world’s largest indoor botanical garden with over 200 plant species, cutting-edge water treatment systems, and sustainable energy solutions.

The resort is designed around three key zones:

  • Play Zone – A family-friendly area with 15 waterslides, interactive entertainment, and experiential art.
  • Relax Zone – Indoor and outdoor mineral pools, steam rooms, and natural treatments.
  • Restore Zone – A thermal complex with saunas, steam rooms, and mineral treatment baths.

Therme Dubai will accommodate 1.7 million visitors annually and include a Michelin-star restaurant, three 18-meter waterfalls, and 4,500-square-meter pools. The project will also include an exciting play area with 15 waterslides and immersive art installations aimed at enhancing the overall customer experience. Its sustainable engineering will recycle 90% of its water and rely on 80% clean energy for cooling.

Beyond leisure, the project aligns with Dubai’s Quality of Life Strategy 2033, which focuses on enhancing community well-being and creating sustainable urban spaces. The design of Therme Dubai reflects Dubai’s commitment to environmental responsibility, with features such as green architecture, energy-efficient systems, and eco-friendly construction materials. The integration of natural elements within the urban setting aims to foster a healthy and vibrant lifestyle for Dubai’s residents and visitors. By incorporating wellness, culture, and sustainability, the project strengthens Dubai’s global position as a wellness and tourism hub.

  • Academic Area: This area features college buildings, advanced educational and administrative facilities, offices for administrative and academic staff, the General Training Administration, a health center, and a 1,000-seat theatre.
  • Sports Area: Equipped with 17 sports facilities, this section includes an indoor gym, indoor and outdoor swimming pools, a football field, outdoor courts for tennis and volleyball, and a residential hotel with 26 rooms for sports teams.
  • Main Academy Field: Designed to accommodate 2,500 attendees and spectators, this area includes a 'training city' for police operations.

Designed to the highest international standards, the development comprises two interconnected high-rise commercial towers—one rising 37 storeys and the other 22 storeys—offering a dynamic and efficient workspace tailored to modern business needs.

The towers feature flexible office layouts, advanced building management systems, and high-quality finishes that enhance both functionality and aesthetics. Catering to multinational corporations, financial institutions, and professional service firms, the development provides a prestigious business address within Abu Dhabi’s premier financial district. Additionally, the project incorporates sustainable building practices and energy-efficient systems, ensuring long-term operational efficiency and compliance with global environmental standards.

The towers will be constructed above two levels of basement and three podium levels, along with ancillary buildings and a mosque. The development also includes ground-floor retail spaces, a flagship rooftop dining venue, extensive landscaping, and enhancements to the surrounding public realm.

Strategically positioned in the heart of Al Maryah Island, the project ensures seamless indoor connectivity to Al Maryah Tower, The Galleria Al Maryah Island, and Abu Dhabi Global Market Square. It also provides direct access to key locations such as Abu Dhabi City, Al Reem Island, and Saadiyat Island.

With a total built-up area of approximately 233,965 square meters, the development integrates state-of-the-art infrastructure and facilities to support high-performance commercial operations.

projects.name: SKAI by RAK Properties
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of SKAI, a premium waterfront residential development on Raha Island in Mina Al Arab, Ras Al Khaimah. SKAI will feature 272 luxurious apartments and penthouses spread across two towers, offering stunning views and top-tier amenities. The towers, one with 19 residential floors and the other with five, are connected by the SKAI Club, an integrated podium that serves as a hub for social and recreational activities.

The SKAI Club will offer residents a thoughtfully designed space to support an active, wellness-focused lifestyle. It will include a fully equipped clubhouse, a swimming pool with a spacious pool deck, padel courts for sports enthusiasts, as well as a state-of-the-art gym and wellness facilities to promote a balanced and healthy lifestyle.

Strategically located in the heart of Raha Island, SKAI offers prime access to one of Ras Al Khaimah's most exciting new districts. The development is positioned near the upcoming Four Seasons Resort and Residences Ras Al Khaimah, set to enhance the area’s appeal and further establish Mina as a leading destination for luxury living.

Residents will also enjoy seamless access to the Harbour District, with a lively boulevard, marina, restaurants, cafes, boutiques, and expansive public spaces, providing a dynamic living experience in an exceptional setting.

projects.name: Disneyland - Yas Island
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Disneyland Abu Dhabi, a groundbreaking theme park and resort that marks Disney’s first foray into the Middle East and its seventh global resort. Situated on Yas Island—a renowned entertainment hub already hosting attractions like Ferrari World, Warner Bros. World, and SeaWorld Abu Dhabi—the new park aims to blend Disney’s iconic storytelling with the rich cultural heritage of the United Arab Emirates.

Disneyland Abu Dhabi is envisioned as the most technologically advanced and interactive park in Disney’s portfolio and its most “tech-forward” park yet. The design will feature innovative attractions, immersive experiences, and a unique central castle inspired by crystal formations, symbolizing a fusion of modern aesthetics with traditional Emirati elements.

The resort will offer a variety of themed attractions, accommodations, dining, and retail experiences that integrate Disney characters and narratives with local cultural motifs. The waterfront location allows for creative incorporation of water-based attractions, enhancing the immersive environment.

Disneyland - Yas Island is a greenfield mega urban development project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 10000.0 million, at design. Developed by Miral Developers,Miral Developers,The Walt Disney Company. projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a destination resort in Dubai. The MOON Dubai is set to involve the construction of a 274-meter replica of the moon atop a 30-meter building. It will feature the world's largest sphere with a diameter of 229 meters.

The development includes various luxurious elements, such as 'The Private Residence at MOON Dubai' consisting of 500 upscale residential units, an exclusive Private Members Club, a boutique Six Star hotel with 100 suites, and a Five Star hotel with 4000 suites. Guests can look forward to over 50 integrated components, including an exceptional attraction that allows them to walk on the Lunar Surface and explore an authentic Lunar Colony, which is a signature experience offered by MOON. The resort will include amenities such as a spa and wellness section, a nightclub, an arena with the capacity to host 10,000 people, a global meeting place, a lounge, and an in-house moon shuttle.

The project is expected to add to the emirate’s economy in sectors such as hospitality, entertainment, attractions, education, technology, the environment, and space tourism upon completion. projects.name: Durar Moonstone South - Al Marjan Island

The project involves the construction of a branded residential tower called Moonstone South situated in Al Marjan Island. The project comprises 200 residential units, including one-bedroom, two-bedroom, three-bedroom, and four-bedroom apartments, as well as unique luxury villas and these exquisite apartments boast Missoni-designed interiors.  Additionally, there are four commercial units  located on the ground floor.

The residential apartments consist of 62 one-bedroom units with an average area of 865 sq.ft, 98 two-bedroom units with an average area of 1,500 sq.ft, 30 three-bedroom units with an average area of 2,360 sq.ft, and four four-bedroom units with an average area of 6,290 sq.ft. Furthermore, the project features six unique villas with an average area of 8,300 sq. ft. The commercial units include two units of 710 sq. ft. each and two units of 283 sq. ft. each.

The building's layout incorporates a single-loaded corridor design, ensuring unobstructed sea views. Each apartment boasts a spacious continuous balcony measuring 2.4 meters wide, providing ample outdoor living space. The balcony is equipped with movable sunscreens, allowing residents to adjust the shading, while the full-vision glass panels offer uninterrupted vistas of the Arabian Gulf waters.

The amenities include a swimming pool, gym, steam room, sauna, spa, and playgrounds.

Durar Moonstone South - Al Marjan Island is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Ras Al Khaimah, valued at USD 80.0 million, at design. Developed by Durar Properties. projects.name: Mira Coral Bay - Al Mairid - Al Marjan Island
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a mixed-use development in the Al Mairid area, Ras Al Khaimah offering a diverse array of high-end accommodations and amenities. The project will feature a 5-star branded spa hotel with 100 keys and a resort hotel boasting 250 rooms. For those seeking a more private retreat, the development will include six clusters of villas comprising 165 units, two clusters of townhouses with 128 units, and four clusters of apartments totaling 650 units.

At the heart of Mira Coral Bay will be a state-of-the-art yacht club and two exclusive branded beach clubs, catering to maritime enthusiasts and sun-seekers alike. Culinary aficionados will delight in the 10 premium branded restaurants scattered throughout the development. The mixed-use project will incorporate underground parking and scenic walkways, with a unique architectural design that seamlessly integrates the environment and outdoor facilities while prioritizing pedestrian comfort.

Situated just 10 minutes from Downtown Ras Al Khaimah, Mira Coral Bay will offer residents and visitors unparalleled access to the emirate's vibrant city life while providing a tranquil waterfront escape. This harmonious blend of urban convenience and natural beauty positions Mira Coral Bay as a grand jewel in the Al Mairid area, promising an unmatched living experience for those fortunate enough to call it home.

projects.name: 106 Villas & 102 Mansions - The Acres - Dubailand
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of an exclusive standalone villa community in Dubailand, offering a range of premium residential units. The final phase includes 106 luxury villas and 102 exquisitely designed mansions, as part of The Acres Estates.

The community offers a selection of 3, 4, and 5-bedroom villas, along with the Amber and Ivory Collections featuring 5, 6, and 7-bedroom mansions. Each residence is designed to provide a seamless blend of indoor and outdoor living spaces, with centrally located kitchens, grand master bedroom suites, spacious bathrooms, and unique courtyard designs that maximize natural light and privacy.

The Acres Estates offer expansive plots ranging from 9,000 to 17,700 sq. ft., with private gardens connected to green pedestrian pathways leading to the park and lagoon. The Amber Collection showcases a contemporary aesthetic with clean lines and natural materials, while the Ivory Collection incorporates a more traditional design with vertical stone-clad walls and minimalist white horizontal lines.

Residents will benefit from extensive green spaces, with each villa located within a three-minute walk from a park. The community offers a strong social infrastructure, including the Halo Loop Park, a nursery, a school, a clinic, mosques, clubhouses, retail areas, and an Edible Garden. Lifestyle amenities include a trail network, outdoor gym, playgrounds, swimming pools, and sports areas.

Strategically positioned in Dubailand, The Acres provides convenient connectivity with direct access to Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street and Emirates Road. It is located just 10 minutes from Global Village and five minutes from Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club and Hamdan Sports Complex, making it an attractive residential destination.

The project involves the construction of a residential building comprising 2 basement levels, a ground floor, a mezzanine floor and 10 additional floors located in Ras Al Khaimah, comprising studio, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments. The project will accommodate fully furnished apartments, along with a swimming pool, playground, sports facility, spa, and barbecue. Situated on Al Marjan Island, the project will offer distinctive architectural solutions, modern amenities, and a flowing design, set to become a prominent landmark in the region, redefining luxury living in Ras Al Khaimah.

Positioned near the world’s largest Wynn Casino, pristine beaches, and premium hotels, Manta Bay introduces a new standard of luxury living. Its notable features include the world’s highest beach, expansive terraces, shimmering pools, and extensive open spaces, providing stunning views and refined living. With amenities such as sports arenas, beach volleyball, and diverse leisure facilities, Manta Bay ensures an unparalleled lifestyle experience. Manta Bay proudly unveils the world's first sandy rooftop beach, towering at an impressive 197 feet. Offering more than 30 deluxe amenities, including cigar lounges and beach bars.
Manta Bay - Al Marjan Island is a greenfield mid rise (4 - 14) project in Ras Al Khaimah, valued at USD 270.0 million, at tender. Developed by Major Developers. Lead consultant Federal Engineering Consultant; MEP consultant Federal Engineering Consultant. Main contractor New System Engineering & Constructions Llc. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: City Walk Crestlane 2 by Meraas
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of City Walk Crestlane 2, a premium waterfront residential development located in City Walk, Dubai. This high-end project is designed to offer panoramic water views, seamlessly blending modern urban living with luxury and sustainability.

As part of the broader City Walk Crestlane master plan, City Walk Crestlane 2 is a multi-building complex situated in City Walk Phase 3. It comprises two buildings—City Walk Crestlane 2 Building A and Building B—with 201 residential units, including a mix of one- to four-bedroom apartments and duplexes.

The residences feature double-height living spaces, exclusive terraces, and high-quality finishes, including elegant kitchens, spacious bedrooms, and luxurious bathrooms. Residents will have the option to enjoy breathtaking views overlooking the Dubai skyline or the shores of Jumeirah Beach.

The project integrates with the existing City Walk streetscape, incorporating mid-rise plots set amidst lush parks, cascading streams, and water features. The layout is designed to enhanxce connectivity between indoor and outdoor spaces, fostering a vibrant community atmosphere.

City Walk Crestlane 2 by Meraas is a greenfield mid rise (4 - 14) project in Dubai, valued at USD 125.0 million, at concept. Developed by Meraas. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Safa by Arada - Aljada Residential City
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Safa, a premium residential community that forms part of the larger Aljada megaproject in Sharjah, UAE. Comprising five architecturally distinct apartment buildings (B+G+8/9F), the development will house a total of 660 high-end residential units. These units include a range of one- to three-bedroom apartments, each designed with modern, contemporary aesthetics and built to provide a luxurious living experience. Every home within Safa is equipped with smart home features for enhanced convenience and security, alongside standard white goods such as kitchen appliances, ensuring that residents move into fully functional, ready-to-live-in spaces.

The Safa community is strategically placed within the Aljada master plan, offering residents unparalleled access to world-class amenities. In addition to the individual unit features, residents will have exclusive access to an indoor gym and a shared swimming pool, promoting a healthy and active lifestyle. Furthermore, the development enjoys direct access to the West Boulevard, a beautifully landscaped, tree-lined promenade that hosts a variety of shopping and dining outlets, enriching the living experience with a blend of convenience and leisure.

The location is further enhanced by its proximity to the Aljada sports complex, a sprawling 400,000 square-foot park that provides an extensive range of outdoor sports facilities. These include a full-size football pitch, smaller 5-a-side pitches, basketball courts, padel tennis courts, volleyball courts, squash courts, and badminton courts. For those seeking more recreational activities, the park also features cycling and jogging tracks, as well as adventure play areas for children.

Safa by Arada - Aljada Residential City is a greenfield mid rise (4 - 14) project in Sharjah, valued at USD 283.8 million, at design. Developed by Arada. Lead consultant Mimar Emirates Engineering Consultants (Sharjah); MEP consultant Mimar Emirates Engineering Consultants (Sharjah). No contractor appointed. projects.name: Lumena by Omniyat
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Lumena, a 49-storey (plus 7 basement levels) ultra-luxury commercial tower in Business Bay, Dubai. Strategically positioned on Sheikh Zayed Road near the Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai, Lumena is set to redefine the commercial real estate landscape with its bold architectural design and focus on wellbeing, performance, and innovation.

Rising to a height of 260 metres, the tower will feature 91 shell-and-core office units divided into three categories: 59 standard office units (three per floor plate), 30 half-floor units (two per floor plate), and 2 full-floor offices. With an internal office area of 582,184 sq. ft., the development incorporates flexible floorplates, rear-core layouts, minimal internal columns, and 3-meter clear ceiling heights to maximize spatial efficiency and adaptability. High ceilings, full-height windows, and biophilic design elements aim to bring natural light, greenery, and airflow into every workspace.

Architecturally, the tower’s sculpted façade and cantilevered structures provide panoramic views of Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, Jumeirah Beach, and the Burj Al Arab. Shared amenities and vantage points are integrated throughout the structure to promote occupant engagement and comfort. With over 1,000 parking spaces and proximity to Business Bay Metro Station, the development ensures seamless connectivity to key business and lifestyle destinations in Dubai.

Lumena is also designed to embrace future-proof technology, innovation, and sustainability, offering full fit-out flexibility for tenants and buyers to customise spaces according to their vision.

Lumena by Omniyat is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 930.0 million, at design. Developed by Omniyat Property Development Corporation (Binary Development Ltd.). Lead consultant Gad Architecture,Gad Architecture. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Trio Isle Interiors by Missoni - Al Marjan Island
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Trio Isle Interiors by Missoni, a premium residential development located on Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah. The development consists of three high-rise towers with 704 units, each designed to blend Middle Eastern elegance with Italian luxury. The architectural design features sleek, linear facades with expansive glass windows, allowing for ample natural light and uninterrupted ocean views.

The residential units include a mix of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, all outfitted with its distinctive use of bold colors and geometric patterns. The project offers a resort-like lifestyle with three levels of podiums, three swimming pools, three restaurants, and three lobbies, creating an exclusive living experience. Residents will also have access to more than 25 premium amenities, including a gym, infinity pool, kids’ play area, sports courts, dining outlets, and retail spaces.

Located on a man-made island spanning 2.7 million square meters and extending 4.5 kilometers into the Arabian Gulf, Trio Isle Interiors by Missoni provides a tranquil waterfront setting with pristine beaches, breathtaking sunsets, and modern conveniences. The development is positioned to attract both investors and residents seeking a luxurious and serene lifestyle in Ras Al Khaimah.

Trio Isle Interiors by Missoni - Al Marjan Island is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Ras Al Khaimah, valued at USD 1200.0 million, at tender. Developed by Octa Properties,Durar Properties. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: HQ by Rove - Business Bay
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a 31-storey office tower in Business Bay, Dubai, under the brand of Rove Hotels, developed by Irth Group. The building is designed as a Class A commercial property with 23 floors of office spaces and 8 levels of parking. Each office floor covers approximately 22,500 sqft (2,090 m²) and can accommodate up to 22 offices, which can be combined into customised workspaces. Office units range from 625 sqft (58 m²) to 5,790 sqft (538 m²), including executive penthouses with double-height ceilings and private terraces.

The tower features contemporary interiors inspired by Rove Hotels, including ergonomic furniture, private terraces, fully furnished move-in-ready offices, and meeting rooms. The development also offers panoramic views of Burj Khalifa, Dubai Design District, and Dubai Creek Harbour.

HQ by Rove includes 988 parking spaces with valet services, EV charging stations, and bicycle parking. It has 21 high-speed lifts, including dedicated service and shuttle lifts. The building also provides extensive facilities: a gym, event spaces, food hall, co-working and creative workspaces, lounges, and meeting rooms. A corporate concierge, HQ Desk, offers call handling, IT support, courier services, secretarial assistance, and workspace booking.

Strategically located in Dubai’s primary business district, the tower is adjacent to Marasi Bay and close to DIFC, Downtown Dubai, Dubai Design District, major malls, Sheikh Zayed Road, and Dubai International Airport.

HQ by Rove - Business Bay is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 250.0 million, at concept. Developed by Rove Hotels,Irth Group. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Bay Grove Residences - Dubai Islands
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a multi-building complex on Dubai Islands, Deira, featuring four distinct buildings: Bay Grove Residences Building 1, Building 2, Building 3, and Building 4. Together, they will house an estimated 296 premium units, including stylish one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as luxurious four-bedroom penthouses.

Phase 3 of the development, located on the southern coast of Island B, introduces 241 additional residences, thoughtfully designed to elevate beachfront living. This phase includes a mix of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, along with sea-facing four-bedroom duplexes that offer expansive layouts, curved balconies, and floor-to-ceiling windows, providing panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and a seamless connection to outdoor spaces.

The new buildings in Phase 3 are set within a landscaped podium with basement parking and include modern lifestyle amenities such as an infinity lap pool on the upper podium, a fully equipped fitness centre, and a children’s club. Residents will benefit from direct access to Crystal Beach, an adjacent park, and a raised oceanfront pool, all fostering a resort-style environment that blends comfort, leisure, and community.

Nestled in a prime location, the Dubai Islands offer residents an exceptional blend of natural beauty and waterfront leisure. This coastal paradise spans 50 kilometers of expansive waterfront and boasts 20 kilometers of pristine beaches. Enhanced by new infrastructure, including the Infinity Bridge connecting the islands to the city center, it seamlessly merges urban convenience with scenic tranquility.

Residents will enjoy a vibrant community surrounded by lush green spaces, a premium golf course, and upscale waterfront dining, alongside numerous beachside attractions. The complex will also feature a range of amenities, including balconies, BBQ areas, children's play areas, a state-of-the-art gym, leisure facilities, a shopping complex, a swimming pool, and a selection of restaurants, ensuring a lifestyle of luxury and comfort.

Bay Grove Residences - Dubai Islands is a greenfield mid rise (4 - 14) project in Dubai, valued at USD 100.0 million, at design. Developed by Nakheel (Pjsc).
